descriptions: Fixed the Cancel and Load Outfit footer buttons ignoring the selected language, because the client looked up the keys Cancel and Load Outfit while the language files define cancel and loadFit
Added nine keys the interface requested but no language file defined, including wardrobe_list, save, saving, wardrobeExitSelect and deleteSelectedOutfits, which until now printed the raw key
Fixed the outfit_limit_reached, saveFitError and skin_reset_success notifications rendering their key instead of a message
Fixed the missing default skin error and the admin panel permission refusal being hardcoded English, both now resolve through _L
Fixed shop blips, target labels and the [E] prompt using untranslated Config.ShopBlips labels, while custom labels set in the admin panel are left untouched
Translated the camera preset panel in all nine languages, it had been copied from en.lua and never localised
Translated the remaining English values in the German, Polish, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese and Korean files
